sentences.text: The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Daltonganj P.S. Case No. 115 of 2024, for the offences registered under Sections 376(2)(n) and 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Exclusive Special Judge (POCSO), Palamau at Daltonganj.

entities.text: Exclusive Special Judge (POCSO), Palamau at Daltonganj
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Petitioner is alleged to have raped the victim, who was in intoxicated condition in the year 2018.
It is further alleged that the petitioner continued to stalk her and ultimately, on 22.03.2024, he started threatening the victim and her friends.
Thereafter, this case has been instituted.
Considering the fact that there is inordinate delay of six years in lodging of F.I.R regarding the occurrence of rape, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner,
named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Exclusive Special Judge (POCSO), Palamau at Daltonganj, in connection with Daltonganj P.S. Case No. 115 of 2024.

opennyai_summary.facts:
The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Daltonganj P.S. Case No. 115 of 2024, for the offences registered under Sections 376(2)(n) and 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the POCSO Act, pending in the court of learned Exclusive Special Judge (POCSO), Palamau at Daltonganj.
Petitioner is alleged to have raped the victim, who was in intoxicated condition in the year 2018.
It is further alleged that the petitioner continued to stalk her and ultimately, on 22.03.2024, he started threatening the victim and her friends.
opennyai_summary.decision:
Considering the fact that there is inordinate delay of six years in lodging of F.I.R regarding the occurrence of rape, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.
Accordingly, the petitioner,
named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Exclusive Special Judge (POCSO), Palamau at Daltonganj, in connection with Daltonganj P.S. Case No. 115 of 2024.
